title: Don’t Know What
description: Breathing, speaking and blinking are the raw ingredients with which Thomas Renoldner subverts the language of filmmaking. No surprise then that this witty and irreverent film has been picking up prizes everywhere, including at the Ottowa Animation Film Festival and an Off Limits award at Annecy.

music: but the party’s over. Baggage carousels and supermarket conveyors trundle aimlessly. Disco balls spin and water sprinklers sprinkle. Where has everyone gone? Set to Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14
animator Geoffroy de Crécy presents us with a world that continues on
but without humanity to witness it.
